appearances.snippet: And they accidentally left their computer open, so Court TV captured some of that footage. And you can see that it is literally the exact same video as 12.4, but it's been zoomed in.

verification.notes: The hearing transcript confirms Exhibits 12.1 and 12.4 use the same underlying compilation, but it directly says 12.1 differs through red overlays, face blurring, and zooming, not only zoom. The episode supports Owens’s statement that media briefly captured material, but her only-zoom characterization omits material enhancements.
